name: Bizard — Biomedical Visualization Atlas
title_zh: 报个基因名就出火山图、热图、富集图的 R 画师
tagline_zh: 不用记 ggplot 语法，不用翻 Stack Overflow。说一句「画个火山图」，它自己挑配色、调坐标。
tagline_en: Skip ggplot syntax and Stack Overflow. Say "volcano plot" and it picks colors, axes, and labels—ready for journal.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever the user asks about data visualization, biomedical charts, scientific figures, or bioinformatics plots. Trigger keywords include: visualization, visualize, R绘图, 可视化, plot, chart, figure, graph, R visualization, R plotting, ggplot, ggplot2, biomedical visualization, bioinformatics visualization, omics plot, genomics plot, clinical chart, gene expression plot, volcano plot, h
why_zh: 把散落几十个 R 包的绘图流程收成一套点单式接口，按生物信息惯例预设了配色、阈值线和基因标注。
why_en: Turns scattered R packages into a menu-driven interface, with bioinformatics defaults for colors, cutoffs, and gene.
limit_zh: 只认 R 和 Bioconductor 生态，输入得是表达矩阵或差异分析结果；不处理单细胞数据、不做统计检验。
limit_en: R/Bioconductor only; needs expression matrix or DE results. No single-cell, no stats, static plots only—no interactive dashboards.
title_en: Name a gene, get volcano, heatmap & enrichment plots
